# Clavis 3.8.1

## 🌍 Every window in your language

- Clavis is now fully translated into **French, German, Tamil and Hindi** — Settings, Sharing, Secure Notes, Backups, Watch Folders, Browse Encrypted, Open Files, Activity, recovery keys, updates and every message along the way. (Settings → Language, then restart.)

## ✨ Fixes

- Text no longer gets cut off in any language: long buttons move onto a second line, explanations wrap neatly, and Hindi words are never split in half.
- In Sharing, the Close and Encrypt buttons always stay in view, and the fingerprint label shows correctly in Tamil and Hindi.
- Fixed the wording of the "Watch Folder not found" and "Watch Folder was deleted or moved" messages.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now).
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
